data.citation: Fanaee-T, H. (2013). Bike Sharing. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

rule: Ordinary at zero report age and valid prediction, else calendar-only

checks: 0h masking, causal lags, rolling mean and availability
1h masking, causal lags, rolling mean and availability
3h masking, causal lags, rolling mean and availability
6h masking, causal lags, rolling mean and availability
Current/future target perturbation cannot change present/past features
Hidden reports cannot affect masked features
Naturally missing hours are not converted to zero
Training masks deterministic for fixed seed
Invalid outage arguments rejected
Irregular hourly grid rejected
No history yields NaN, not an invented count
Fallback precedence and train-only median
Report-age convention equals declared delay when history is complete
Natural missing report and no history trigger stale/unknown ages
Changing current/future target availability cannot alter present/past ages
Hidden observations cannot change masked report age
Fresh, stale, unknown and invalid-primary routing preserves fallback values
Routing leaves caller arrays unchanged
Bad shapes, ages and fallback numbers rejected
Invalid delay arguments rejected
All five schedules deterministic with one delay per day
Frozen public prediction hash and UCI target identity verified
Identical 2,208 rows in every schedule/method; no duplicated predictions
Finite nonnegative outputs; exact repeated routing parity

limitations: Same previously exposed city/quarter; not independent validation.
Synthetic daily delays; not measured real-world outage frequency.
Report timestamps assumed correct; no >23h delay evaluation.
Models and original masking draws frozen; no new model fits or uncertainty intervals.
